source.name: 2x2_locality_ordered
source.description: Same tensor identity as 2x2.json, ranks permuted to minimise the summed live width of the output blocks (19 -> 14). Rank order is a free gauge; a shorter live range means a C tile's successive TMA reduce-add contributions are closer in time and more likely to hit in L2 instead of round-tripping to DRAM.
